{"arguments": {"content": "import sys
import openpyxl

spreadsheet_path, output_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"] if "Sheet1" in wb.sheetnames else wb.active

# Build lookup from the Data table (headers at row 3, data rows 4+).
# Data table: key1 col = I, key2 col = J, value col = K
data = {}
for row in range(4, ws.max_row + 1):
    key1 = ws.cell(row=row, column=9).value
    key2 = ws.cell(row=row, column=10).value
    val = ws.cell(row=row, column=11).value
    if key1 is not None and key2 is not None:
        data[(key1, key2)] = val

# Table headers (row 3): column letters A-D at columns C,D,E,F
headers = {ws.cell(row=3, column=col).value: col for col in range(3, 7)}

# Fill answer range C4:F6 by looking up (row label, col header)
for r in range(4, 7):
    row_label = ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value
    for c in range(3, 7):
        col_label = headers[ws.cell(row=3, column=c).value]
        val = data.get((row_label, col_label))
        if val is not None:
            ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value = val

wb.save(output_path)
print("saved", output_path)", "path": "/bench/answers/39931/solution.py"}, "name": "write"}
